planets.name: TOI-199 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-199 with a 105-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-199 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-199. Its orbit and size follow Hobson et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
